title: Reviewer follow-up: "call termal_submit_review_result exactly once per review" lets a resumed reviewer skip the new attempt's structured result, so the host fails the follow-up
outcome: Reviewer follow-up: "call termal_submit_review_result exactly once per review" lets a resumed reviewer skip the new attempt's structured result, so the host fails the follow-up
acceptance: The reviewer instructions and the termal_submit_review_result tool description say a structured result is required once per host-issued submission attempt, and that a follow-up on the same reviewer opens a new attempt that needs its own submission

A focused test or fixture shows that a follow-up reviewer turn with a new reviewResultSubmissionAttempt is told it must submit for that attempt, and that the original attempt's stored result stays intact
